excluded_runs.explanation: CD9660 mode-zero bug made copied test scripts unreadable; fixture now installs explicit modes.
Incorrect home Xauthority assumption; separate manual continuation succeeded with the recorded authority.
Initial candidate fixture incorrectly expected unflagged UID/GID overrides; corrected fixture follows native filesystem behavior.
Under paging the 1.2-second startup timer stopped live-burst before all 25 intended processes existed; all 22 tracked descendants were absent. Readiness-based replay succeeded.

limitations: Two primary cold-boot stability runs, one baseline and one candidate; this is bounded coverage, not a soak or universal stability claim.
Original native child-control stalls, failed catalog-batch halt and transient Acrobat XTest timeout were not reproduced or explained.
The native CD9660 bug is independently reproduced and does not establish the cause of those earlier stalls.
Baseline CD fixture had 12 wrong unflagged UID/GID expectations; the unreturned fields fail with either expected value. Its 92 failures remain baseline evidence, with fixture hashes preserved.
The paging-sensitive live-burst startup assertion is corrected in the fixture; production process supervision is unchanged.
Ordinary graphical GL captures and private input receivers do not reproduce the earlier exact Acrobat PDF/software-readback sequence.
No new manual CHD is promoted in this cycle; the candidate core is qualified only in disposable overlays.
